analysis.session_summary: The window was dominated by a geopolitical whipsaw in Iran headlines: a 10:30 Iran Strait reopening proposal triggered a brief risk rally, then later Trump comments reversed it into a firm-USD close. Brent/USD closed +0.655%, SPX/USD +0.152%, and VIX/USD -2.803%, but high-beta FX remained soft. Currency strength map shows USD +0.168% and NZD +0.181% outperforming, while EUR -0.155% and GBP -0.163% lagged. Outside the 10:15 Iran leg, many legs had no clear catalyst and were flow or technical.

themes.evidence: The Iran headline at 10:30 caused sharp legs: USD/JPY -86.7 pips, EUR/USD +30.5 pips, Brent/USD -450.5 pips. Later Trump comments 'Urged Iran To Negotiate' pushed EUR/USD -8.5 pips and GBP/USD -10.2 pips in their legs.
USD mean vs majors +0.168%, DXY/USD +0.237%, while EUR -0.155%, GBP -0.163%, CAD -0.153%.

themes.theme: Risk sentiment mixed but oil bid
themes.evidence: SPX/USD +0.152% and VIX/USD -2.803% suggest equity calm, but Brent/USD +0.655% and safe-haven JPY +0.138% reflect lingering geopolitical premium.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped in a 48.7-pip range, rallied 30.5 pips on the Iran Strait headline, then gave back 30.8 pips into the close to end -32.3 pips at 1.14371.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD traded a 65.6-pip range, up 31.7 pips on the Iran headline before a 39.9-pip late-session down leg left it -38.7 pips at 1.33307.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY had a 94.5-pip range, fell 86.7 pips on the Iran opening proposal, then recovered 58.4 pips to close +4.5 pips at 157.46.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD moved in a 33.4-pip range, gaining 23.0 pips on the Iran headline but finished -17.7 pips at 0.71059.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD swung 54.3 pips, rising 26.5 pips on the Iran headline before giving back 26.6 pips, closing +0.7 pips at 0.57204.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF chopped in a 41.0-pip range, dropping 34.9 pips on the Iran headline then rebounding 30.6 pips, closing +4.6 pips at 0.82154.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD traded a 53.3-pip range, dipped 17.0 pips on the Iran headline but then rallied 41.1 pips into the close to end +39.4 pips at 1.40706.

polarity_reads.read: EUR basket moved only 0.014%, inside the noise floor; no fresh policy impulse, implying markets are not positioned for near-term ECB repricing.
AUD own-ccy impulse was +0.066%, but with no forecast to score the surprise; modest AUD strength suggests no hawkish surprise was priced.
USD basket moved 0.020%, inside the noise floor; despite geopolitically charged headlines, FX did not treat Trump's comments as new information.

scenarios.name: USD firm, range consolidation
scenarios.thesis: The tape ended with USD strength and high-beta FX heavy after the Iran rally faded. Absent a new geopolitical catalyst, expect consolidation near session ranges with USD remaining firm.
triggers: Iran opening proposal lacks concrete follow-through
Trump says he urged Iran to negotiate
Calendar PMIs print close to forecast
scenarios.invalidation: A confirmed high-level US-Iran meeting or actual Strait reopening arrangement.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed -32.3 pips at 1.14371; USD strength vs EUR persists.
GBP/USD -38.7 pips at 1.33307; cable remains under pressure.
USD/JPY closed +4.5 pips at 157.46; limited yen strength in consolidation.
USD/CAD +39.4 pips at 1.40706; CAD weakness supports firmer USD/CAD.

scenarios.name: Risk-on de-escalation follow-through
scenarios.thesis: If Iran talks progress and Strait reopening becomes concrete, the earlier risk-positive reaction extends: high-beta and commodity currencies rebound, and yen weakens.
triggers: Equity gains accelerate and VIX stays subdued
scenarios.invalidation: US or Iran walks back the proposal or rhetoric escalates.

pair_paths.rationale: The Iran headline earlier lifted EUR/USD 30.5 pips; follow-through could retest that leg.
GBP/USD rallied 31.7 pips on the Iran headline leg.
AUD/USD gained 23.0 pips on the same de-escalation leg.
Late-session USD/JPY recovery of 58.4 pips highlights yen softening in risk-on conditions.

scenarios.name: Risk-off escalation
scenarios.thesis: If Iran tensions re-escalate or Trump's isolation push intensifies, safe havens JPY and CHF strengthen, high-beta FX sells off, and oil rallies further.

Trump escalates economic isolation of Iran
